reference.scope: Exact committed master VPX and browser snapshot, including its continuous HTML music player. No injected table instrumentation or chooser correction. Engine cache is read only. Individual comparison probes declare any observers or external inputs separately.

scope: Twelve normally created native live-ball pairs under unchanged original functions. Normal UI focus loss pauses physics; declared VBS component inputs set pose/velocity and move to the solved contact. The observer performs no WASM memory writes, address assignment or outcome restoration. Original HitTest/Collide mutate only the created component balls. This is component/allocator evidence, not uninterrupted gameplay.
